name: Agent flow
use: How one account worked, step by step: its records top to bottom in time order, consecutive records on one place merged into a step, and at each step the accounts it answered (left) and that answered it (right), by reply, by name or by editing the same place next.

account.description: the account whose records are the steps

within.description: only the account's records this label gave `value` (its first value when none is given)

places.description: only the account's records on these pages or channels

links.description: the kinds of link shown, all three when none is given

edges.description: links your code computed, from a record's ref to an earlier record's, which the records themselves do not carry
